question: Do CD estimators derived from the existing fold-clean point-probability maps (frozen detector, point specialist) carry signal that a leave-one-fold-out log-space blend can add to the adopted recipe A pipeline (four-flip TTA + LOFO scalars, OOF 8.985)?
why_first: Phase 1 found point-detector CD at 16.6% MAPE and FFT CD too weak; the Phase 2 ridge stacking of five map features worsened every fold. Before spending GPU time on density heads or self-training, measure the ceiling of the current maps directly: MAPE of each estimator after fold-clean log-linear calibration, its error correlation with recipe A, and the LOFO blend gain. This bounds what detector improvements could buy.

design.rows: 8954 OOF rows minus the 20 rows whose point labels a head saw (point_labels_seen) = 8934 scored and fitted rows
design.base: seed-46 tta4 x LOFO scalar per held fold (exactly the adopted pipeline; reproduces 8.9757 on the 8934 rows)
design.features: per map on the in-frame 122x162 grid: soft mass; peak counts at thresholds 0.35 and 0.5 (local maxima within +-2 cells); mean nearest-neighbour spacing and 1/spacing^2 among peaks; peak count inside the 37x37-patch (0.052 mm^2) window with highest mean probability / highest mean peak confidence; median window count among top-quartile mean-probability windows; soft mass in the best-probability window
design.estimator: log CD = a + b log f, least squares on the four fitting folds
design.blend: w in [0,1] step 0.02 chosen on the fitting folds minimising CD MAPE of exp((1-w) log base + w log est); applied to the held fold
metrics: per fold and overall: estimator CD MAPE, base CD MAPE, blended CD MAPE, delta CD pp, Pearson r of log errors
mean-score delta = CD delta / 3 since CV and HEX are untouched
design.intercept_recheck: LOFO intercept-only log-space L2 calibration vs the adopted MAPE-optimal scalar, to quantify how much of the earlier stacking's +0.07..0.10 pp was loss mismatch rather than feature harm

pre_specified_decision.screen_pass: best estimator blend improves CD by >= 0.09 pp overall (0.03 pp on the mean) and on >= 2 folds
pre_specified_decision.if_pass: treat as a candidate; confirm with the submission gate only after an independent re-implementation of the chosen estimator (multiplicity over ~24 estimators)
pre_specified_decision.if_fail: record the best MAPE and error correlation as the current-map ceiling; a detector improvement is only worth GPU time if it can plausibly reach CD MAPE <= 8% with r <= 0.5 (the blend-gain arithmetic that yields 0.03 pp)

falsification: If every estimator has blend delta >= 0 on most folds, point-map-derived CD from the current maps carries no fold-clean complementary signal.
